Bruno Fernandes Retained as Manchester United Captain Following Internal Discussions

01 Nov 2026, 10:43 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Sports Desk · Source: www.bbc.co.uk

Leadership Continuity Confirmed

Manchester United head coach Michael Carrick has affirmed that Bruno Fernandes will remain the club's captain. The clarification follows a period of speculation regarding the player's role after he was relegated to the bench during Sunday’s 3-0 home defeat against Bournemouth.

Carrick characterized the decision to exclude Fernandes from the starting lineup as a tactical choice specific to that fixture, rather than a permanent change in hierarchy. Following the match, the pair participated in discussions at the Carrington training facility on Tuesday to address concerns and align on the team's direction.

Key Takeaways from the Discussion

Carrick emphasized the stability of the leadership structure, noting the following points:

  • Full Commitment: The head coach stated that Fernandes remains "fully committed" to the club and the goal of improving the team’s recent performances.
  • No Issues: Carrick dismissed suggestions of a rift, asserting there are "absolutely no issues" regarding the captaincy.
  • Performance Focus: The leadership is prioritizing team cohesion as they head into a challenging schedule, including upcoming matches against Chelsea, Roma, and Aston Villa.

Context of the Current Run

Manchester United is currently navigating a difficult period, having gone eight matches without a victory—the club's longest winless streak since the 2015-16 season. The team is currently approaching a historic unwanted milestone, as they have not endured a nine-game winless sequence since the 1988-89 campaign.

Regarding his own position, Carrick stated that he has not sought specific assurances from club leadership, which includes minority owner Sir Jim Ratcliffe and executive staff. He expressed an understanding of the responsibilities inherent in his role and remains focused on attempting to improve the squad's results.

How to Verify
